decision: APP SERVICE CAPACITY PURCHASE DECISION REQUIRED

currentPlan.name: asp-jm1-web-prod-linux
currentPlan.observedMeter: Azure App Service Standard Plan - Linux S1 App

recommendedTarget.option: Scale out asp-jm1-web-prod-linux from 1 to 2 S1 workers before production cutover
recommendedTarget.why: Two workers are the simplest supported change that preserves the existing plan/SKU, doubles aggregate CPU and memory headroom, and avoids moving five production sites into a single worker already near 80% memory before public traffic.

alternatives.option: Scale up to a larger single worker
alternatives.tradeoff: Could add per-worker capacity but does not add worker redundancy; exact cost not observed in the successful pricing query.
May isolate properties, but adds operational complexity and should be chosen only if telemetry later proves shared-plan contention.

blockedActionUntilDecision: Do not perform public DNS/custom-domain cutover for the five non-Publishing sites.
